name: Vanilla but Harder
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: LavishAujla
description:
makes vanilla Minecraft harder. 
Makes it always night, armour makes you take damage (except turtle shells and elytras), limited crafting, reduced debug info, can't sleep, can't heal naturally, and the eye of ender is harder to craft.
evidence: Data only, no Java code: Horizon's mod browser imports its data; nothing for Kiln to run.
